defs.def: concerned with principles of right and wrong behaviour 道德的

ex.s: Being emotionally intelligent does not necessarily make one a moral person.
ex.t: 情商高并不一定使人成为有道德的人。

ex.s: The similarity of moral virtues across cultures is striking, even though the relative ranking of the virtues may vary with a social group’s history and environment.
ex.t: 道德美德在各文化间的相似性令人惊叹，尽管这些美德的相对排序可能随社会群体的历史和环境而变化。

defs.def: based on your own sense of what is right and fair, not on legal rights or duties 道义上的；道德上的

ex.s: Despite various debates, there’s no agreement on what it means to be morally good.
ex.t: 尽管有各种争论，但对于什么是道德上的善，人们并没有共识。

ex.s: Morgan says，”To give people a guilt-free option that they can wear without someone throwing paint on them-1 think that’s going to be a massive thing, at least here in New York.” Designer Jennifer Anderson admits it took her a while to come around to the opinion that using nutria fur for her creations is morally acceptable.
ex.t: 摩根说：“给人们一种毫无愧疚感的选择，让他们穿上也不会被人泼油漆——我认为这会是一件大事，至少在纽约这里。”设计师詹妮弗·安德森承认，她花了一段时间才接受在其创作中使用海狸鼠毛皮在道德上可以接受的观点。

defs.def: following the standards of behaviour considered acceptable and right by most people 品行端正的；有道德的

ex.s: We found that those rated as more moral reported a stronger sense of well-being.
ex.t: 我们发现，那些被认为更有道德的人报告了更强的幸福感。

ex.s: Instead, people with stronger moral character tend to experience greater meaning in life and happiness.
ex.t: 做到清晰简洁——同时保持趣味性并包含听众需要知道的所有信息——这是一种高水平的沟通技巧。

defs.def: able to understand the difference between right and wrong 能辨别是非的
standards or principles of good behaviour, especially in matters of sexual relationships 品行，道德（尤指性关系方面）

ex.s: In 1870, when Dickens died, the world mourned him as its first professional writer and publisher, famous and beloved, who had led an explosion in both the publication of novels and their readership and whose characters — from Oliver Twist to Tiny Tim— were held up as moral touchstones.
ex.t: 1870年狄更斯去世时，世界哀悼这位首位职业作家和出版人，他声名显赫、深受爱戴，引领了小说出版与读者群的爆发式增长，其笔下人物——从奥利弗·崔斯特到小蒂姆——被视为道德试金石。

ex.s: Of course, the greatest dilemmas arise from moral problems, when we are uncertain which choice results in doing the right thing.
ex.t: 当然，最大的困境源于道德问题，当我们不确定哪种选择才能做对时。

ex.s: We could also say Of course, the biggest dilemmas are caused by moral problems, when we are not sure which choice will help us do the right thing.
ex.t: 我们也可以说：当然，最大的两难困境是由道德问题引起的，当我们不确定哪个选择会帮我们做出正确的事时。

ex.s: A moral dilemma is a situation in which you have two or more difficult choices to make.
ex.t: 道德困境是指你有两个或更多艰难选择要做的情况。

ex.s: To do a test on people’s morals.
What can be inferred about the forming of the Inuit’s moral code?
ex.t: 关于因纽特人道德准则的形成，能推断出什么？

ex.s: Share your opinions about a moral story 1 What was the king’s idea for teaching an important lesson to his people?
ex.t: 分享你对一个道德故事的看法 1 国王想用什么办法给人民上一堂重要的课？

ex.s: In a world where nearly 800 million people a year go hungry, “food waste goes against the moral grain,” as Elizabeth Royte writes in this month’s cover story.
ex.t: 在一个每年近8亿人挨饿的世界里，"食物浪费违背道德准则，"伊丽莎白·罗伊特在本月封面故事中写道。

ex.s: This suggests that moments of moral effort may be part of a life that, taken as a whole, feels more satisfying.
ex.t: 这表明，道德努力的时刻或许正是这样一种生活的一部分：整体来看，它让人感到更满足。

defs.def: a practical lesson that a story, an event or an experience teaches you 寓意；教益

ex.s: Each fable teaches a life lesson that Aesop summarises in a short phrase at the end of the story, called a moral.
ex.t: 每则寓言都教给人一个人生道理，伊索在故事结尾用一句简短的话总结，称为寓意。
